title: Package Python Dependencies for AWS Lambda with Layers
description: Runnable companion for the Lambda Layers recipe: manual and Docker-based layer builds, the automated build-layer.sh script, SAM and Serverless Framework configs, and packaging helpers.
description_es: Proyecto ejecutable complementario de la receta de Lambda Layers: builds manuales y con Docker, el script build-layer.sh automatizado, configs de SAM y Serverless Framework, y helpers de empaquetado.
